-- go.mod --
module example

go 1.19
-- main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
)

func main() {
	got, err := exec.LookPath("bolero")
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println(err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}

	want := filepath.Join(os.Getenv("BOLERO_ROOT"), "bin", "bolero" + os.Getenv("GOEXE"))
	if got != want {
		fmt.Printf(`exec.LookPath("bolero") = %q; want %q\n`, got, want)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}
-- $WORK/bin/README.txt --
This directory contains no executables.
